sources.title: GitHub - pymss-project/pymss-studio: Cross-platform desktop GUI for ...
sources.snippet: The desktop app is a wrapper around the external pymss package. Core separation algorithms and model behavior live in pymss; this repository focuses on the desktop product, frontend workflow, Tauri orchestration, and release packaging.

sources.title: GitHub - pymss-project/pymss: Inference package for music source ...
sources.snippet: The official plugin registry is a separate pymss-plugins repo (a registry.json mapping short names to sources) — point pymss install <name> at a custom one via PYMSS_PLUGINS_REGISTRY. Write a plugin — a standard pyproject.toml with [project].name / version / dependencies is all pymss needs (no pymss-specific fields).

sources.title: Pymss Studio
sources.snippet: Tauri 2 + Vue 3 + pymss core Pymss Studio 面向音乐源分离的跨平台桌面工作台：模型管理、批量任务、结果归档与分轨编辑一体化。它把外部 pymss 核心能力包装成完整桌面产品，让制作人、研究者和高频用户无需进入命令行即可完成分离流程。

sources.title: Pymss · Open-source Music Source Separation
sources.snippet: Pymss is an open-source, free, fully local music source separation toolchain: vocals, drums, bass and more — every stem in one click, on your own machine.
